name: The Velvet Underground

whyMatters.en: NYC band with Warhol association; The Velvet Underground & Nico (1967) is the delayed-influence blueprint for punk, noise, and indie drone/dissonance.
whyMatters.zh: 与 Warhol 关联的纽约乐队；The Velvet Underground & Nico（1967）是朋克、噪声与 indie 持续音/不协和的延迟影响蓝图。

lyricQuotes: Heroin, be the death of me / Heroin, it's my wife and it's my life

shortBio.en: Reed / Cale avant-rock; Heroin is the 1967 drone-narrative document.
shortBio.zh: Reed / Cale 前卫摇滚；Heroin 是 1967 持续音叙事文献。

body.en:
Formed 1964 in NYC. Debut with Nico, White Light/White Heat, and later Reed-led albums used viola drone, feedback, deadpan lyric, and minimal chord vamps outside AM-psych fashion.

Heroin (1967) is the listed track. Commercial failure at release; citation density in punk/post-punk/indie histories is the measure of impact.
body.zh:
1964 年于 NYC 组建。与 Nico 的首专、White Light/White Heat 及后期 Reed 主导专辑：中提琴持续音、反馈、冷脸歌词、极少和弦反复，落在 AM 迷幻时尚之外。

Heroin（1967）是列出曲目。发行时商业失败；朋克/后朋克/indie 史中的引用密度才是影响尺度。

note.en: Two-chord vamp plus viola drone; deadpan lyric outside AM psych.
note.zh: 两和弦 vamp 加中提琴持续音；冷脸歌词落在 AM 迷幻之外。

note.en: Cale viola scrape and Reed monotone; debut-era Factory sound.
note.zh: Cale 中提琴刮擦与 Reed 单调念白；首专 Factory 声。

note.en: 17-minute feedback jam; White Light/White Heat noise peak.
note.zh: 17 分钟反馈 jam；White Light/White Heat 噪声高峰。

title.zh: 朋克之前的持续音与不协和

body.en:
The 1967 debut with Nico documents two-chord vamps, Cale's viola drone, and Reed's flat vocal—Heroin and Venus in Furs sit outside Summer of Love polish.

White Light/White Heat (1968) pushes feedback and Sister Ray's long-form noise. Warhol Factory association is media context; the tapes are the musical fact.
body.zh:
1967 年与 Nico 的首专记录两和弦 vamp、Cale 中提琴持续音、Reed 平声念白——Heroin 与 Venus in Furs 落在 Love 之夏抛光之外。

White Light/White Heat（1968）推反馈与 Sister Ray 长形式噪声。Warhol Factory 关联是媒介语境；磁带才是音乐事实。

title.zh: Reed/Cale 峰值 vs Cale 离队后 Reed

body.en:
Peak citation: Reed, Cale, Morrison, Tucker on the 1967–68 run. Cale exits 1968; Loaded (1970) adds Sweet Jane and cleaner rock mix.

Nico guested vocals on the debut only; Tucker’s floor-tom style and minimal kit are part of the early silhouette.
body.zh:
引用峰值：Reed、Cale、Morrison、Tucker 的 1967–68 周期。Cale 1968 离队；Loaded（1970）加入 Sweet Jane 与更干净 rock 混音。

Nico 仅在首专客座人声；Tucker 地鼓式打法与极简鼓组是早期剪影的一部分。

title.en: Delayed citation in punk and indie
title.zh: 朋克与 indie 里的延迟引用

body.en:
Pixies and Sonic Youth cite the noise-to-melody ratio; Joy Division and The Smiths cite the deadpan and minor-key minimalism. Talking Heads share the NYC art-school orbit.

Influence is bibliographic—1970s sales were low; 1980s–90s reissues fixed the canon.
body.zh:
Pixies 与 Sonic Youth 引用噪声/旋律比；Joy Division 与 The Smiths 引用冷脸与小调极简。Talking Heads 共享 NYC 艺术院校轨道。

影响是文献性的——1970 年代销量低；1980–90 年代再版固定了 canon。
